title: SESSIONS.md entry
description: The JSON an agent generates for scripts/session-record.sh, which validates it, renders the entry, and writes it. `session` is the key: recording the same session again updates its entry in place rather than adding a second one, so a long session can be recorded when it starts and refined as it goes.

session.description: Harness session id. The key: it identifies which entry to update, so it must be the same string every time this session is recorded.

status.description: in-progress while the session is still running; done when it ended; abandoned when it stopped without finishing. A reader treats an in-progress entry's `next:` as live.

subject.description: What the session did, as a heading. No markdown heading marker; the renderer adds it.

agent.description: Harness and model, e.g. 'claude-code · opus-5'. The model is not in the environment — state it.

resume.description: Command that resumes this session. Omit rather than invent one; the renderer writes 'not resumable' when absent.

worktree.description: The path that gets a later reader back to the files.

head.description: Tip commit at the end of the session, so a reader can tell what has since been rebased away.

work.description: What changed and what it proves. Carry the evidence class: a VM proof is not a physical-host claim, a read-only audit is not a change. Name what the result did not establish.

refs.description: Issues and PRs as [Issue #n](url), joined with ' · '. Say 'none' and why when there is no forge item.

next.description: The first thing to do on resume. An entry without it is just a commit log.
